entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand tracker. Now. I'm looking at my order and this is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Sarah Miller, order 774-B-91. Look, I don't want a big song and dance. I just want my money back.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker. I understand your frustration. To make sure I resolve this correctly, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

There's no 'issue'! It's not broken. I just **changed my mind**, alright? It was a stupid **impulse buy** around the holidays and I just **don't use it**. It's been sitting in the box. Now, are you going to give me my refund or do I need to speak to your manager? Because I will light up your company on every review site I can find.

I understand completely. There's no need for a manager, I'm confident I can handle this for you. I see here that you're one of our VIP members, Sarah; we really appreciate your business. Let me just take one moment to review the return eligibility for you.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I've just reviewed our policy. I see you received the VeloBand 18 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you right now.
Oh. Really? You're just... going to approve it? Just like that?

Yes, of course. As a valued VIP member, we want to ensure you're taken care of. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive a pre-paid shipping label in your email within the next 5 minutes. Once our warehouse receives the item, the refund will be issued to your original payment method. And as a thank you for your patience, I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchases.
Wow. A $25 credit? Okay. Thank you, David. I... I apologize for my tone earlier. I just expected a fight.
It's not a problem at all, Sarah. I'm just happy I could resolve this for you. Will there be anything else today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
